note: Scene 3 (café) routines, v10. Holds in ms; [a,b] = random in range. Each actor runs independently and out of sync. RULE: fade_ms (a true cross-dissolve into a still) applies ONLY between two stills of the same loop. Every other change is an instant cut. Within a layer every still is pixel-identical to the first outside the part that moves, so cuts never flicker. The fan is part of the room: play its loop forever, do not apply the 'fully painted under actors' edge rule to it, and let the edge fade it like the plate. v10 (2026-11-26): OLD MAN reads on O_1 only (the newspaper never changes) and turns a page every 5-7 s in six drawn steps, cuts: O_1 > T1 (corner lifted) > T2 (page rising) > T2b (page carried) > T3 (page laid on the left) > T3b (arm on its way back) > T4 (hand back) > O_1, 130/130/140/160/150/130 ms (0.84 s; the longer holds come before the longer moves, so the hand travels at an even speed); he blinks on O_1 only, about every 3-6 s (O_blink, 100 ms). BARISTA polishes in a circle, cuts at 140-200 ms: B_1 > B_P1 > B_2_polish > B_P2 > B_3_polish > B_P3, 3-6 rounds, then her pause and glance (B_4_glance) as before. MUM (part of the plate; her layer holds patches only) sips once per loop of about 18-24 s: rest > M_S1 (220 ms) > M_S2 (sip, eyes closed, 1.4-1.8 s) > M_S1 > rest; her blinks are scripted at four points in the loop, never during the sip. CAT: cat_3 is gone. Its tail flicks twice per loop: cat_1 > cat_F1 (110 ms) > cat_F2 (500 ms) > cat_F1 (110 ms) > cat_1, at the start of the loop and again after 3 breaths (2 more follow), so at about 60% of the loop. It breathes (cat_1/cat_2, 1 s dissolves) the rest of the time, never during a flick; each breathing loop ends on cat_1 so the flick starts with a cut from an identical body.

reaction.note: On a mushroom find. Stills only; the head lift is hidden inside a blink.

rachel.note: The coffee sip is four drawn poses with cuts: A1 > S1 (stylus down, hand to cup) > S2 (cup lifted, eyes half closed) > B1 (sip) and back. No blink during S1/S2/B1. If a mushroom is found mid-sip, finish the sip (B1 300 ms > S2 > S1 > A1) and then play the reaction.

barista.note: Polishing: the cloth circles the cup through three drawn in-betweens, cuts at 140-200 ms (dissolves were tried and looked muddier: the cloth moves too far between neighbours). Glance: eyes only.

child.note: Colours with his head down (C_1/C_2, the crayon moves with a short dissolve), then looks up at his mum and grins (C_3, cuts).

oldman.note: Reads on O_1, the only reading pose, then turns the page in six drawn steps with cuts (T2b and T3b are the in-betweens that even out the sweep: 46-82 px of hand travel per step). O_1 is three holds in a row (the same still, so nothing shows between them) because the engine fits at most one blink into a hold: this way he blinks every 3-6.5 s and turns a page every 5-6.5 s (5th-95th percentile, measured over 50 min of the engine rules). He blinks only on O_1, never mid-turn.

cat.note: Flick at the start of the loop and after 3 breaths (about 60% of the loop). Each breathe loop is cat_1 > cat_2 > cat_1: the two cat_1 holds meet when it repeats (an identical still, so nothing shows) and it always ends on cat_1, ready for the flick.

mum.note: Part of the plate: null = nothing drawn. One sip per loop of about 18-24 s; her blinks are written into the loop (four, 4-6 s apart), never during the sip.
